app.name: Goodnotes: AI Notes, Docs, PDF
app.description: Goodnotes is an AI-powered note-taking and PDF annotation app that lets you handwrite, type, record audio, and collaborate on documents across devices.

verdict.one_liner: Strong privacy promises for your notes, but extensive third-party sharing and ad tracking are concerning.
verdict.summary: Goodnotes makes a clear commitment never to sell your notebook content and keeps your notes on your device by default, which is excellent. However, the app shares user data with over 20 third-party companies for analytics, marketing, cloud infrastructure, and AI services. It also uses cookies and Google Customer Match for targeted advertising, claiming legitimate interest for ad personalization even beyond cookie consent. The AI features require explicit opt-in but then share your notes and conversations with external AI providers.
verdict.recommendation_reason: While Goodnotes protects your note content from being sold, the extensive third-party data sharing, behavioral tracking for ads, and AI data processing make this a cautious choice for privacy-conscious users.

red.title: Data shared with many third-party companies
red.plain_english: Goodnotes shares your data with more than 20 outside companies for analytics, advertising, cloud storage, customer support, and AI features. Some of these companies may be located in countries with weaker privacy laws.

red.title: Targeted ads based on your activity
red.plain_english: Goodnotes tracks how you use the app and website to show you personalized ads. They also share your data with Google to find people similar to you for marketing purposes. They claim a legal basis of legitimate interests for the actual ad targeting, which means you may not have a clear way to fully opt out.

red.title: AI features can access your notebook content
red.plain_english: If you use Goodnotes AI, your notes, conversation history, and inputs may be shared with AI providers like Amazon and Microsoft to train and improve their models. You must explicitly opt in, but once you do, your content leaves the app.

red.title: Your location is tracked automatically
red.plain_english: Goodnotes automatically collects your device's location and IP address, which can be used to figure out roughly where you are. This is used for analytics and marketing, not for the core note-taking features.

red.title: Policy can change without clear re-consent
red.plain_english: Goodnotes can change its privacy policy at any time. They say they will try to notify you, but they do not guarantee you will get a clear alert or need to agree again before the changes apply.

green.title: They promise not to sell your notes
green.plain_english: Goodnotes explicitly says they never sell or rent your data or notebook content to third parties. This is a strong and clear commitment.

green.title: Your notes stay on your device by default
green.plain_english: Unless you back up to their cloud or iCloud, your notes and documents are stored only on your device and not on Goodnotes servers. They also say they will not access your notebooks without your permission.

green.title: You have real data rights
green.plain_english: They give you GDPR rights like accessing, deleting, and exporting your data. Some of these actions can be done directly in the app without needing to email them.

green.title: No sensitive health or biometric data collected
green.plain_english: Goodnotes specifically says they do not collect special category data like health information or biometric data from your handwriting. They also do not create individual profiles from your handwriting style.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes can access your microphone when you choose to record audio notes. The app doesn't upload these recordings to its own servers without your permission, but if you back up to Goodnotes Cloud or iCloud, the audio files may be stored there.
categories.detail: The app offers audio recording as a feature. The privacy policy states they do not access or collect data from notes/documents without consent. Audio recordings would be treated as user content.
categories.policy_excerpt: We don't access or collect data from your notebooks or documents without your permission.
concerns: Policy doesn't explicitly address microphone permissions
Audio recordings could be backed up to third-party cloud services

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes automatically collects your device's location and IP address, which can be used to figure out roughly where you are. This is used for analytics and marketing, not for the core note-taking features.
categories.detail: The policy mentions collecting 'details of the location of the device used and IP address' as part of automatically collected usage data. IP addresses are also collected from website users for location and timezone.
categories.policy_excerpt: usage data when you visit or otherwise use the Services, including details of the location of the device used and IP address
concerns: Location inferred from IP address
Automatic collection without clear opt-out

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes does not access or collect your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: No mention of contacts or phonebook access in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes accesses your files when you import PDFs or documents into the app. Your notes stay on your device unless you choose to back them up to Goodnotes Cloud or iCloud.
categories.detail: The app is designed for note-taking and PDF annotation. Files are stored locally by default. Cloud backup is optional.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create notes or documents when using the Services, these are stored on the Goodnotes application on your device - Goodnotes does not store your notes or documents on its own servers and does not access or collect such data without your permission.
concerns: Optional cloud backup shares data with third-party infrastructure providers

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes shares your data with more than 20 third-party companies for analytics, marketing, customer support, cloud storage, and AI features. While they say they don't sell your data, some sharing is for advertising purposes like Google Customer Match.
categories.detail: Extensive list of third parties including Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, AWS, Microsoft, HubSpot, Braze, and others. Google Customer Match is used for advertising. They claim third parties are under confidentiality obligations.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may disclose and transfer your Personal Data to our agents, contractors or vendors... We use Mixpanel and Amplitude to collect information about the usage of our app... To provide lists of certain customers' data to Google to enable us to engage with these customers through their Google-affiliated accounts and to find an audience of people with similar characteristics or demographics to these customers for our marketing purposes.
concerns: Over 20 third-party services receive data
Google Customer Match for advertising profiling
Data shared for AI model training and testing
Some service providers may be outside UK/EEA

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes collects your name, email, country, and language when you sign up. This information is also used for marketing and advertising personalization if you consent.
categories.detail: Basic personal identifiers are collected at registration. Also used for marketing communications and targeted advertising with consent/legitimate interests.
categories.policy_excerpt: basic Personal Data about you (personal identifiers and contact information such as first name, family name, email address, country and your language)
concerns: Account data used for marketing and advertising
Shared with Google for Customer Match

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes tracks how you use the app and website to show you personalized ads. They use cookies and share your data with Google to find similar people for marketing. They claim a legal basis of legitimate interests for the actual ad targeting even when you haven't given clear consent.
categories.detail: Uses Cookies and similar technologies for profiling and targeted advertising. Google Customer Match uses hashed customer data. They collect opt-in consent for cookies but rely on legitimate interests for the actual personalization/targeting advertising activities.
categories.policy_excerpt: To carry out data driven marketing via our use of Cookies and similar technologies to enable Goodnotes and its business partners to track your engagement with the website and our Services for profiling purposes... we will rely on the legitimate interests condition in relation to the personalisation and targeting advertising activities that we carry out
concerns: Legitimate interest claimed for targeted advertising despite cookie consent
Cross-site tracking via Google Customer Match
Profiling for marketing purposes

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Children under 16 aren't supposed to sign up on their own, but there's no clear enforcement mechanism like age verification mentioned in the policy.
categories.detail: Policy states children under 16 are not permitted to sign up by themselves. No mention of COPPA compliance or age verification mechanisms.
categories.policy_excerpt: Children under the age of 16 are not permitted to sign up by themselves for the Services.
concerns: No age verification mechanism described
App features may appeal to students including minors

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes logs your IP address and internet activity, which is used to figure out your location and for marketing analytics.
categories.detail: IP addresses collected automatically. Used for location inference, security, and analytics.
categories.policy_excerpt: usage data when you visit or otherwise use the Services, including details of the location of the device used and IP address
concerns: IP address used for location inference and profiling

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes collects your device type, unique device ID, storage usage, and timezone automatically. This data is used for analytics and to improve the app, and some of it is shared with advertising partners.
categories.detail: Collects device type, unique device identification, storage usage, data usage, time zone settings. Used for analytics and shared with marketing partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: activity data relating to your usage of the Services, which reveal your preferences, interests, or manner of use of the Services and the times of use, e.g., IP address, device type, other unique device identification, storage usage, data usage, time zone settings, etc.
concerns: Unique device identifiers collected
Device data shared with advertising and analytics partners

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes does not collect health or biometric data. They specifically state they don't create individual profiles from your handwriting.
categories.detail: Explicitly states they do not collect special categories of Personal Data including biometric data, and they do not process handwriting data to create individual digital templates or profiles.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not collect special categories of Personal Data... we do not consider that we process any biometric data about you

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: If you make a purchase, your payment details are handled by third-party processors like Paddle. Goodnotes doesn't store your full credit card information directly.
categories.detail: Payment card info collected and stored by third-party payment processors. Goodnotes may collect limited info like postal code and transaction history.
categories.policy_excerpt: if you make a purchase, your credit card or debit card information (such as card type and expiration date) and other financial data that we need to process your payment may be collected and stored by third party payment processors with which we work.
concerns: Limited transaction data collected by Goodnotes

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request to delete your data and exercise other rights under privacy laws. Some requests can be made directly in the app, but certain data may be kept for legal reasons.
categories.detail: GDPR rights available including access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction, objection. Some rights exercisable via app. Data may be retained for legal obligations.
categories.policy_excerpt: The right to request that we erase your Personal Data in certain circumstances. Please note that there may be circumstances where you ask us to erase your Personal Data, but we are legally entitled to retain it.
concerns: Some data retained for legal obligations
Deletion process not fully detailed

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Goodnotes can change its privacy policy at any time. They say they'll try to notify you, but they don't guarantee you'll get a clear alert or need to agree again.
categories.detail: Changes can be made at any time with notice on site, app, or by email 'where possible'. No requirement for active re-consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Company reserves the right to make changes to this Policy at any time by giving notice to its users on the site, the Goodnotes application, or as notified by us to you (by email for example), where possible.
concerns: No guarantee of advance notice
No requirement to actively re-agree
